decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a core expression of its strategic direction, it is highly complementary to its consulting and integration business and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's established enterprise geospatial offering and customer base well, so it is worth retaining unless it is folded technically into a broader platform.

The search extension was still being versioned and presented as an active web-map component, and such add-ons support the firm's broader solution portfolio even if they face some risk of consolidation or replacement.
